notes.title: Update Ver.1.05 – Report on Gameplay Improvements and Future Plans
notes.notes:
【Gameplay Improvements】
To enhance the gameplay experience, we have implemented the following updates:

Added language support for Traditional Chinese and Korean.

Adjusted the behavior of some enemies to enhance the horror atmosphere.

【Planned Future Updates】
Based on feedback from players and live streamers, we plan to address the following:

Overall game content volume
Some players have expressed that the experience from start to finish feels too short.
We are considering the addition of new modes and new mechanics.
A major update is planned in the near future—please stay tuned!

Microphone issues on specific setups
If you are experiencing microphone detection issues,
we kindly ask you to share your environment details in the “Bug Reports [Dev Team]” thread in the Community Hub.
Your input will help us improve the game.

We will continue updating the game to deliver the experience we originally envisioned.
Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Update Ver.1.02: "Gameplay Improvements and Upcoming Fixes"
notes.notes:
[Gameplay Improvements]
We have implemented the following updates to enhance the overall gameplay experience:

Revised the behavior of the “white circle” that appears when caught by an enemy. It will now slowly fill up if even a small amount of voice is detected, but will require a loud scream to fill quickly. This allows players to better distinguish between when no sound is being picked up and when their voice is simply too quiet.

Previously, the "scream" effect was unintentionally effective in all directions, making it possible to clear the game by simply shouting constantly, which led to a monotonous experience. We have now adjusted this so that screams only affect the area in front of the player.

Clarified the traits of certain enemies. In addition, when the player gets a Game Over due to specific enemies, an advice message will now appear to assist in understanding how to avoid them.

Fixed an issue that made it difficult to encounter certain enemies.

Adjusted the number of keys required in some stages.

Adjusted the scream detection threshold to reduce false triggers from regular speaking during livestreams.

Balanced the volume of certain background music (BGM) and sound effects (SE).

Added a UI at the beginning of the game to explain the characteristics of each difficulty mode.

[Bug Fixes]

Fixed various minor bugs to improve stability and gameplay.

[Upcoming Fixes and Improvements]
Based on your feedback and gameplay streams, we plan to address the following:

Lack of overall content volume
Many players have commented that the experience from start to finish feels too short.
We are considering adding new game modes and gameplay mechanics to expand the experience.

We will continue improving the game through future updates to ensure it aligns with the experience our development team aims to deliver.
Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Update Ver.1.01: "Bug Fixes and Upcoming Improvements"
notes.notes:
[Bug Fix Report]

We have implemented fixes for the following issues:

Fixed a bug where the "white circle"—which responds to microphone input—would sometimes stop functioning when the player was caught by the enemy.
Additionally, in cases where the microphone is detecting sound but the scream volume is insufficient to trigger a response, a message will now appear indicating that the volume is too low.

Fixed an issue where the retry function would not work on the retry screen.
Specifically, we addressed a bug where the mouse cursor would not appear, preventing players from selecting the retry button.

[Upcoming Fixes and Improvements]

Thanks to your feedback and gameplay streams, we have identified several areas for improvement. We are currently reviewing the following issues:

Lack of overall game volume
Many players have noted that the experience from start to finish feels too short. We are exploring ways to expand the gameplay content.

Overly strict detection of the “white circle” when caught
Even when players intentionally scream, the input may not be recognized. We are considering adjustments to make the detection more forgiving.

Streaming issue where regular speaking triggers a “scream”
In streaming situations, normal talking can unintentionally count as a scream and raise the scream threshold. We plan to make adjustments for better compatibility with live commentary.

Unclear difference between “STREAMER” (highest difficulty) and other modes
We will improve the UI and in-game descriptions to better highlight the unique features of each mode.

These issues do not align with the experience we aim to deliver, and we are committed to addressing them in future updates.
